notes: asking_price: .mn-detail-price contains the price value (e.g. '$75,000'). revenue: found inside .mn-detail-stats as a .mn-detail-stat block whose .mn-detail-stat-label text is 'Gross sales'; the value is in the sibling .mn-detail-stat-value. cash_flow: same pattern with label 'Net cash flow'. Both may show 'Contact broker' when not disclosed on a given listing, but the field is present on the page structure on all pages. city and state: .mn-detail-location contains a combined 'City, State' string (e.g. 'Nassau, New York') — parse by splitting on the comma.
